total_model.summary: Model projects 44.4 total points (LAC 23, NE 22). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.2), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.5), Natural grass field (raises total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
